title: Wave 9 Software Domain Adapter Feature Matrix
governing_rules: Software adapts to the kernel; the kernel does not adapt to software
Source code exists != software capability certified
H(K_before) = H(K_after) and H(D_math_before) = H(D_math_after) and H(D_phys_before) = H(D_phys_after)

features: SoftwareRequirement with functional signatures and verification contracts
SoftwareObjective for multi-requirement systems engineering goals
SoftwareMachinery with abstract components, costs, signatures, and evidence
SoftwareEvidence capturing results across { T, U, S, L, F }
SoftwareCertificate with deterministic SHA-256 seal and gate audits
EpistemicSoftwareStatus: SOURCE_SPECIFIED -> STATICALLY_TYPED -> BEHAVIORALLY_TESTED -> CONTRACT_VERIFIED -> CERTIFIED_CAPABILITY
SoftwareCertificationBoundary implementing the 5-Gate boundary C_sw = { T, U, S, L, F }
Gate T (Type & Interface Safety): validates type contract enforcement
Gate U (Unit & Behavioral Tests): validates test suite execution and behavioral adherence
Gate S (Static & Contract Analysis): validates linter, timeout, and side-channel safety
Gate L (Latency & SLA Contract): evaluates execution latency against strict SLA bounds
Gate F (Concurrency & Fault Invariants): validates linearizability, thread-safety, and split-brain resilience
Authority Tier Verification: rejects components requiring higher authority than caller possesses
Empty Evidence Check: enforces source code exists != software capability certified
SoftwareGrammarFactorer enforcing literal frozen 6D coordinates (Delta, I, W, sigma, Pi, Gamma) + circ
Defects and patches mapped to coordinate Delta
Invariants and type contracts mapped to coordinate I
Software test receipts and witnesses registered to coordinate W with Delta d = 0
Functional capabilities and RPC endpoints mapped to coordinate sigma
Boundary interfaces and type reductions mapped to coordinate Pi
Runtime state transitions and control flow mapped to coordinate Gamma
Strict detection and fail-closed rejection of semantic drift and coordinate dimension expansion
SoftwareAdapter implementing canonical domain adapter contract
required_work(requirement) -> WorkContract
candidate_machinery(deficiency, state) -> list[MachineryNode]
factor_grammar(work) -> FactoringAuditRecord
certify(result, evidence, requirements) -> SoftwareCertificate | CertificationResult
measure_ability(requirement, state) -> float
benchmark_corpus: canonical N = 50 requirements corpus spanning 5 systems domains
candidate_machinery: 6 candidate packages (Raft, HMAC, Event Bus, Rate Limiter, Circuit Breaker, Random Control)
Zero concrete implementation dependencies bundled in production package
